mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a weak labor market that triggers central bank easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and housing starts (HOUST) are falling, it indicates a shift from manufacturing to services, which is associated with positive equity returns as the economy transitions to a more sustainable growth path.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates improving economic conditions, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 650.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8.0%, it indicates a dual stress of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During an early-cycle expansion (as indicated by rising industrial production), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 days due to improving corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
